summary: Project-local validation overrides for the active AGENT-REVIEW-WORKBENCH-WAVE-001 dev-only standalone window batch, the default-disabled Codex Computer Use optional validation lane, the completed ZOTERO-DOM-CONTRACT-WAVE-001 advisory DOM contract baseline, the completed ZOTERO-HOST-POLISH-WAVE-001 host-visible polish baseline, and the completed OPTIONAL-BUNDLE-WAVE-001 optional bundle baseline.

overrides.summary: Dev-only Agent Review Workbench changes stay visual-recommended: treat the standalone window as a visible surface, but gate v1 on window lifecycle, JSON state/store resilience, structured annotation CRUD, deterministic plan mapping, diagnostics summary, and workbench-specific acceptance telemetry before any screenshot-only review.
requiredChecks: 继续先通过 `npm run check`、`npm run build`、`npm run agent:host:guard` 与 `npm run agent:host:semantic:guard`，不让 dev-only 工作台破坏 JS core、宿主 contract 或门禁链。

至少验证 workbench command 注册 / trigger semantics：若当前 Zotero runtime 暴露真实 host-visible Prompt / menu / shortcut 入口，则验证该入口；若 `agent.reviewWorkbench.open` 只以 plugin-local fallback command 暴露，则不要把它误判成 command palette host-visible entry，改为在最小内部触发后验证 standalone window open/focus reuse、shell lost-tracking live-window fallback、close/shutdown cleanup 与 profile-local JSON state store 的 load/save/migrate/corrupt fallback。

证明 structured snapshot、annotation CRUD、deterministic plan builder、allowlisted host action execution summary、diagnostics summary 与 monitor/gate workbench acceptance telemetry 已闭环；standalone window 截图只作为补证，不得替代功能验收。
保持 `visual-recommended` 作为 contract enum；中文 `需要视觉验证` 只能作为展示 label，不能回写为 validationLevel 值。
继续保持 `real AI provider`、`React optional lane promotion` 与 `automatic arbitrary source patching` 为 out-of-scope。
nonGoals: 把 dev-only review workbench 升格成产品内用户功能
接入真实 AI provider 或 API key 闭环
通过 workbench 直接执行任意源码 patch

overrides.summary: Default-disabled optional Codex Computer Use real-machine validation lane: it is a governance/tooling sidecar that only creates or records manual desktop validation evidence after an explicit user request, and it must not enter check, Zotero E2E, loop, gate, release gate, or pipeline by default.
requiredChecks: 确认 `config/codex-computer-use-validation.json` 固定 `enabledByDefault=false`、`gateEffect=non-blocking`、`requiresExplicitUserRequest=true`。
确认 `npm run agent:computer-use:validate` 缺少 `--user-requested` 时失败，只有用户主动要求后才会生成 `agent-computer-use-validation` 工件。
确认 `check`、`agent:gate`、`agent:gate:release`、`agent:zotero:e2e`、`agent:zotero:loop` 与 `agent:pipeline` 不调用 Computer Use 支线。
nonGoals: 把 Codex Computer Use 变成默认真机主链或 gate blocker
用桌面宏替代 `agent:zotero:e2e`、surface smoke、surface-local evidence 或 release gate
在未获用户明确要求时自动打开 GUI 或执行桌面操作

overrides.summary: DOM contract hardening on the existing preference pane, item pane, and reader surfaces stays advisory-first: keep the real host actions and route-aware DOM checks visible in E2E / monitor / dashboard / gate output, but do not turn route-level DOM contract failures into a new v1 blocker.
requiredChecks: 继续通过 `npm run check`、`npm run agent:zotero:e2e`、`npm run agent:monitor` 与 `npm run agent:gate` 完成真实宿主闭环。
对 `preference pane / item pane / reader` 输出 route-aware DOM contract 摘要，让测试后能直接读到结构化操作日志，不依赖 Error Console。
DOM contract route 失败在 v1 只记 advisory；除非既有 surface smoke、visual evidence、runtime guard 或 gate 合同失败，否则不单独抬成 blocker。
nonGoals: 把当前波次重新抬回 strict visual-required
扩展到 context pane、menu、child window、iframe、XUL custom element 或 virtualized table

overrides.summary: Host-visible polish work stays visual-required when it touches live interaction consistency, edge-attached geometry, or surface-local evidence on real Zotero surfaces, including collection menu and dynamic submenu verification.
requiredChecks: 完成 in-scope Host Actions 的 surface smoke，并输出逐项 readiness 结果。
涉及 collection menu 或 dynamic submenu 时，同时证明 live collection context、menuPath/child rebuild 与 surface-local evidence 已成立。
对贴边式 surface 同时证明 live geometry 已跟随宿主 bounds，或在过窄时返回显式 degrade 状态。
为成功的 host-visible surface 采集 surface-local evidence；整窗截图仅作为补充。
继续通过 `npm run check`、`agent:host:guard`、`agent:host:semantic:guard` 与 `agent:gate`。
nonGoals: modal / destructive / 需要人工确认的入口自动化
只凭整窗截图判断 surface 正常

overrides.summary: Completed optional bundle baseline: keep the JS core green first, treat react-ui surface bridge as the only implemented lane, and require bundle-local smoke when the default-disabled react-ui lane or the planned wasm-kernel probe contract changes.
requiredChecks: 继续先通过 `npm run check` 的 JS-core 主链，不让 default-disabled bundle 破坏现有 build / verify / gate。
确认 `config/optional-bundles.json`、`build:react-ui`、Wasm probe 文档索引与导出脚手架保持同轮同步。
当 `react-ui` 被启用，或其 window shell / surface bridge / host-mounted demo / host action 改动时，至少补一轮 bundle-local build smoke。

当 `wasm-kernel` 的 probe / digest / unlock 入口、checked-in `.wasm` / worker 资产、host-action bridge、protected semantic 文件、smoke/perf/disabled-contract/matrix 报告或其场景契约改动时，至少补一轮 `tests/wasm-*`；涉及运行时路径或场景契约时，再按改动命中 `npm run zotero:scenario -- --scenario "wasm kernel probe diagnostics"`、`npm run zotero:scenario -- --scenario "wasm kernel digest diagnostics"` 或 `npm run zotero:scenario -- --scenario "wasm kernel unlock diagnostics"` 的 bundle-local smoke。
nonGoals: 在 bundle 默认禁用时把 React 依赖升级成主链强依赖
在 agent-runtime / ai-service 仍为 spec-only 时伪装为已实现
把 probe-backed `wasm-kernel` 误报成 implemented bundle 或默认主线能力
